SqlQuery.GetAllTables: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME;
SqlQuery.CheckStudentsTable:
-- If your migration created Students table:
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.Students', 'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (5) *
    FROM dbo.Students;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    PRINT 'Table dbo.Students does not exist.';
END
SqlQuery.CheckUsersTable:
-- Also check for Users table (in case schema uses Users)
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.Users', 'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (5) *
    FROM dbo.Users;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    PRINT 'Table dbo.Users does not exist.';
END
SqlQuery.CheckIndexes:
-- For Students table
SELECT i.name AS IndexName,
       i.is_unique,
       i.filter_definition
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.objects o ON i.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE o.name = 'Students' AND i.is_unique = 1;

-- For Users table (if present)
SELECT i.name AS IndexName,
       i.is_unique,
       i.filter_definition
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.objects o ON i.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE o.name = 'Users' AND i.is_unique = 1;

-- For Enrollments table
SELECT i.name, i.is_unique, i.filter_definition
FROM sys.indexes i
JOIN sys.objects o ON i.object_id = o.object_id
WHERE o.name = 'Enrollments' AND i.is_unique = 1;
SqlQuery.CheckPrimaryKeysAndForeignKeys:
-- Primary keys for a table (example: Students)
SELECT kc.name AS ConstraintName, kcu.COLUMN_NAME
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS kc
JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu
  ON kc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME
WHERE kc.TABLE_NAME = 'Students' AND kc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY';

-- Foreign key list for the database (shows child -> parent)
SELECT fk.name AS FKName,
       OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS ChildTable,
       cpa.name AS ChildColumn,
       OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS ParentTable,
       rca.name AS ParentColumn,
       fk.delete_referential_action_desc
FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fkc
JOIN sys.foreign_keys fk ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.columns cpa ON fkc.parent_object_id = cpa.object_id AND fkc.parent_column_id = cpa.column_id
JOIN sys.columns rca ON fkc.referenced_object_id = rca.object_id AND fkc.referenced_column_id = rca.column_id
ORDER BY ChildTable, ParentTable;
SqlQuery.CheckRowVersionColumn:
SELECT c.name AS ColumnName, t.name AS DataType
FROM sys.columns c
JOIN sys.types t ON c.user_type_id = t.user_type_id
WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID('dbo.Students') AND c.name = 'RowVersion';
